### Module Finder

Use the filters to find modules by course, training area, level, or keyword.

```{=html}
<div class="landing-filter-panel" data-module-filter>
  <label>
    <span>Keyword</span>
    <input id="module-search-filter" class="landing-filter-search" type="search" placeholder="Search modules">
  </label>
  <label>
    <span>Training area</span>
    <select id="module-area-filter">
      <option value="All">All</option>
    </select>
  </label>
  <label>
    <span>Course</span>
    <select id="module-course-filter">
      <option value="All">All</option>
    </select>
  </label>
  <label>
    <span>Level</span>
    <select id="module-level-filter">
      <option value="All">All</option>
    </select>
  </label>
  <div class="landing-filter-count" aria-live="polite">
    <strong id="module-match-count">0</strong>
    matching modules
  </div>
</div>

<div class="landing-course-grid" id="landing-module-grid"></div>
```

### Courses

The pathway is flexible. Learners can start with core digital practice, then move into responsible AI, automation, or code-based data science.

```{=html}
<div id="landing-course-list" class="landing-course-list" aria-label="Course list"></div>
```
:::
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (char) => ({
    "&": "&amp;",
    "<": "&lt;",
    ">": "&gt;",
    '"': "&quot;",
    "'": "&#39;"
  }[char]));

  const uniqueValues = (items, key) => Array.from(
    new Set(items.map((item) => item[key]).filter(Boolean))
  ).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));

  const setOptions = (select, values) => {
    if (!select) return;
    select.innerHTML = `<option value="All">All</option>${values.map((value) =>
      `<option value="${escapeHtml(value)}">${escapeHtml(value)}</option>`
    ).join("")}`;
  };

  const initModuleFinder = () => {
    const dataElement = document.getElementById("landing-site-data");
    const grid = document.getElementById("landing-module-grid");
    const courseList = document.getElementById("landing-course-list");
    const area = document.getElementById("module-area-filter");
    const course = document.getElementById("module-course-filter");
    const level = document.getElementById("module-level-filter");
    const search = document.getElementById("module-search-filter");
    const count = document.getElementById("module-match-count");

    if (!dataElement || !grid || !area || !course || !level || !search || !count) return;

    let siteData = {courses: [], modules: []};
    try {
      siteData = JSON.parse(dataElement.textContent);
    } catch {
      return;
    }

    const courses = siteData.courses || [];
    const modules = siteData.modules || [];

    setOptions(area, uniqueValues(modules, "area"));
    setOptions(course, uniqueValues(modules, "course"));
    setOptions(level, uniqueValues(modules, "level"));

    grid.innerHTML = modules.map((module, index) => `
      <a class="landing-course-card landing-module-card" href="${escapeHtml(module.href)}"
        data-area="${escapeHtml(module.area)}"
        data-level="${escapeHtml(module.level)}"
        data-course="${escapeHtml(module.course)}"
        data-search="${escapeHtml(`${module.title} ${module.course} ${module.area} ${module.level}`.toLowerCase())}"
        style="--card-delay:${Math.min(index * 35, 280)}ms">
        <span class="landing-card-badge">${escapeHtml(module.course)}</span>
        <span class="landing-card-status">${module.number ? `Module ${escapeHtml(module.number)}` : "Module"}</span>
        <h3>${escapeHtml(module.title)}</h3>
        <p>${escapeHtml(module.course)}</p>
        <span class="landing-card-meta">${escapeHtml(module.area)} · ${escapeHtml(module.level)}</span>
      </a>
    `).join("");

    if (courseList) {
      courseList.innerHTML = courses.map((courseItem, courseIndex) => {
        const glanceItems = courseItem.glance || [];
        return `
          <article class="landing-course-overview-card" data-area="${escapeHtml(courseItem.area)}" style="--card-delay:${Math.min(courseIndex * 60, 240)}ms">
            <div class="landing-course-overview-copy">
              <span class="landing-module-area-kicker">${escapeHtml(courseItem.area)} · ${escapeHtml(courseItem.level)}</span>
              <h3>${escapeHtml(courseItem.title)}</h3>
              <p>${escapeHtml(courseItem.intro || courseItem.summary || courseItem.subtitle)}</p>
            </div>
            <ul class="landing-course-glance-list">
              ${glanceItems.slice(0, 4).map((item) => `
                <li>${escapeHtml(item)}</li>
              `).join("")}
            </ul>
            <a class="landing-card-meta landing-course-overview-link" href="${escapeHtml(courseItem.href)}">View course overview</a>
          </article>
        `;
      }).join("");
    }

    const cards = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll(".landing-module-card"));

    const filterCards = () => {
      const searchTerm = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      let visible = 0;
      cards.forEach((card, index) => {
        const areaMatch = area.value === "All" || card.dataset.area === area.value;
        const courseMatch = course.value === "All" || card.dataset.course === course.value;
        const levelMatch = level.value === "All" || card.dataset.level === level.value;
        const searchMatch = searchTerm === "" || card.dataset.search.includes(searchTerm);
        const show = areaMatch && courseMatch && levelMatch && searchMatch;
        card.hidden = !show;
        card.style.setProperty("--card-delay", `${Math.min(index * 60, 240)}ms`);
        if (show) visible += 1;
      });
      count.textContent = visible;
    };

    cards.forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
        const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        card.style.setProperty("--mx", `${event.clientX - rect.left}px`);
        card.style.setProperty("--my", `${event.clientY - rect.top}px`);
      });
    });

    area.addEventListener("change", filterCards);
    course.addEventListener("change", filterCards);
    level.addEventListener("change", filterCards);
    search.addEventListener("input", filterCards);
    filterCards();
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initModuleFinder);
  } else {
    initModuleFinder();
  }
})();
</script>
```
